decisions.reason: The flagship digital anamnesis line sits close to the core and fits the post-pandemic push to digital, connected practices, so its value is being realized and keeping it costs little.

The education institute reuses existing training content and customer relationships, so it is cheap to keep running even if pandemic disruptions to in-person courses leave its value somewhat uncertain.
Remote screen-sharing support has become an integral, low-cost part of customer service, and remote work during the pandemic likely confirmed its value.
The analytics dashboard builds on the firm's practice data and supports its efficient-practice direction, so keeping this low-cost option open is justified while its uptake develops.
The complete practice bundle mainly packages existing offerings for new and growing practices, so it costs little to maintain and supports sales of the core software.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core and faces strong platform competitors, so its value is the least certain, but a simple portal is cheap to keep while its usage is still unclear.
